info.name: Tulsi ERP API – Phase 1
info.description:
Test collection for `tulsi-erp-backend` (NestJS). Every request carries the right role token, a valid payload, and a test that checks the status code.

**Before you start**
1. `npm run prisma:seed` (demo org + accounts), `AUTO_VERIFY_NEW_USERS=true` in `.env`, then `npm run start:dev`.
2. Set `baseUrl` (default `http://localhost:3000`) and `password` (default `Demo@1234`) in the collection Variables tab.
3. Run **00 · Setup** — it logs in every role and saves tokens / user ids. Then run folders in order (or the whole collection with the Runner).

IDs created along the way (leadId, taskId, leaveId, webhookToken…) are saved automatically and reused by later requests. Requests named **NEG ·** are negative tests that expect an error code.
Access tokens last 15 minutes — re-run 00 · Setup if you start getting 401.

exec: // Dates in IST, refreshed before every request
const d = (off) => { const x = new Date(ist.getTime() + off * 864e5); return `${x.getUTCFullYear()}-${pad(x.getUTCMonth() + 1)}-${pad(x.getUTCDate())}`; };
// 8 digits, used to make emails / phones unique per run
if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('uniq') || pm.info.requestName.startsWith('Login – Super Admin')) pm.collectionVariables.set('uniq', String(Date.now()).slice(-8));
